## Use Cartograph CF in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Cartograph CF for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Cartograph CF', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Cartograph CF coding font

A beautiful programming font designed by a cartographer. Cartograph CF is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Cartograph CF is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Cartograph CF FAQ

### Is Cartograph CF free?

No. Cartograph CF is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Cartograph CF support ligatures?

No. Cartograph CF has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Cartograph CF?

Cartograph CF is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
